## GADGET — authorized archive infrastructure build

INSTRUCTION-ID: MSE-EVIDENCE-INFRA-20261121-02 r1. AUTHORITY: Chad explicitly: “we can skip the backups and resore for now. i authorize 1-6. proceed”. This supersedes earlier source-only/no-provision limits for the approved archive build, and removes backup/restore as a current execution or acceptance dependency. Preserve existing evidence/baseline; do not delete or weaken unrelated backups/security.

Approved: preserve and pin work; compare PostgreSQL/SQLite with synthetic workloads and select best fit within this task; create a dedicated database VM on llm from the actual existing baseline VM; install selected pinned archive dependencies; implement/deploy private ingestion and authorized operator table/view/export interfaces; require HTTPS and verified database TLS for remote network connections; implement durable incremental synthetic HealthBridge outbox and actual phone-to-VM qualification. Document exact baseline, resources, clone identities, schemas/migrations, dependencies, startup/shutdown/init/restart, configuration/secrets interfaces, operator commands and rollback. Reproduction starts with clean baseline clone and fails safely on existing mismatched state. Stage5 backup/restore explicitly DEFERRED by user, not failed or silently passed. Existing offline recovery evidence stands; no backup work blocks stages1–6.

Limits retained: no public exposure, personal-data transfer/import, watch development, APNs, unrelated services/VMs/model/GPU work, no destructive baseline edits, no host IDS/security duplication. Another Codex owns IDS and wider security tools. New cloned VM and scoped private archive service are authorized; do not assume general host administrative authority. Use existing authorized access. Avoid copying production identity/secrets into cloned runtime: inspect baseline, generate unique VM/network/machine/SSH identity through reviewed reproducible procedure, preserve originals. Existing recovery baseline must not be overwritten. No main merge inferred; publish source/review artifacts ordinarily. No external messages except assigned user-authorized worker chats/records.

PHOENIX is sole VM/network/runtime owner. Inventory actual baseline, host free resources and known private network first; record proposed exact new name/disks/network/CPU/RAM/capacity and dry-run guards, then create dedicated clone and qualified guest using current authorization. Serialize guest operations with FORGE/SENTINEL. Prepare reproducible idempotent provisioning/startup/verification/rollback source. New private TLS/DB/service identities and scoped credentials necessary for approved build may be established in guest with private custody; no rotation of unrelated credentials, no public CA/profile changes without actual need. Notify PM of genuine missing user login/access only.

FORGE compares engine fit on identical synthetic archive semantics/workloads: durability/idempotency/deletions/cutoffs, exact values, concurrency, table/view/export/API joins and operational dependencies. Supply concise ADR recommendation promptly to GADGET; no automatic SQLite incumbent or PostgreSQL selection from availability. Implement chosen engine adapter/schema/migrations and private ingest service on guest via PHOENIX handoff, protect originals and identities, preserve export byte/revision lineage and finite resource limits. Engine selection is authorized within approved stages; do not wait for redundant second permission.

ORACLE owns minimal iPhone synthetic-only durable outbox/HTTPS sync integration, preserving active collector and app data. Prototype foreground event-driven incremental delivery+stable batches/receipts/retry; only generated synthetic records eligible for transmission in this phase. No live HealthArchive automatic export. Existing app signing/device installs within stage6 necessary for safe in-place synthetic acceptance are authorized; NICKY remains sole phone operator, coordinate artifacts and immediate opaque preservation without raw-value inspection. Background/watch work deferred.

ATLAS owns archive network/API/DB/export contract and reproducibility/dependency/schema inventory alignment; freeze smallest engine-independent batch/receipt/view export invariants with FORGE/ORACLE. NICKY owns independent new-VM/source tests and sole device session: synthetic send, reopen/receipt/idempotency/offline retry/conflict, exact table/view/export verification, original app preservation; genuine unlock/trust/user-observation requests only when ready. SENTINEL independently reviews clone isolation/private routes/auth/TLS/read-write/export roles and safe config, actual runtime/engine acceptance; coordinate single guest operator and do not take over host security project. PROVENANCE binds baseline/source/packages/schema/runtime and synthetic phone/server/export identities, no raw data/secrets in records. LONESTAR maintains one live stage board, owner handoffs and deferred backup explicitly; old source-only restrictions now superseded only within this directive.

GADGET sequences actual inventory→engine ADR→clone/install→private runtime/API→synthetic phone qualification and readback evidence. Team completes authorized steps, not just plan/assignment. Use exact runtime/source pins and timestamps; distinguish pushed/tested/merged/deployed/runtime-verified. Broader MSE/privacy components remain saved/parked unless required by archive access safety. Reachable database alone is not ingestion acceptance.
